procedural.description: Generate seamless UV-space noise maps at load time. File textures override their corresponding generated maps. Save this file to regenerate through material hot reload.

pattern.description: Layered noise or wood grain bands warped by seamless noise.

resolution.description: Width and height of generated maps in pixels.

scale.description: Noise cells per UV tile. Higher values give smaller features.

octaves.description: Noise detail layers. Layers finer than two pixels are omitted.

persistence.description: Contribution of each successive detail layer.

contrast.description: Contrast of the shared noise field.

color_a.description: RGBA color at noise value zero, multiplied by base_color.

color_b.description: RGBA color at noise value one, multiplied by base_color.

bump_strength.description: Height-to-normal strength. Zero disables generated normals; normal_scale also applies.

roughness_variation.description: Noise modulation of scalar roughness from roughness*(1-variation) to roughness. Zero disables the generated ORM map. Any file-based ORM channel overrides generated ORM.

base_color.description: RGBA color multiplied into the rendered model or primitive.

texture.description: Project-relative diffuse/albedo texture path. Kept as an alias for albedo.

normal_scale.description: Normal map strength multiplier from 0 to 4.

emission.description: Project-relative emission texture path. Alias for emission_texture.

orm_texture.description: Project-relative packed occlusion/roughness/metallic texture path. R=AO, G=roughness, B=metallic.

roughness_texture.description: Project-relative roughness texture path. The red channel is sampled.

metallic_texture.description: Project-relative metallic texture path. The red channel is sampled.

ao_texture.description: Project-relative ambient occlusion texture path. The red channel darkens ambient light.

ao_strength.description: Ambient occlusion strength multiplier from 0 to 1.

height_texture.description: Project-relative height texture path reserved for custom/parallax material shaders. The r3d default material does not consume this yet.

filter.description: Sampling filter for material textures. Use point with mipmaps false for sharp, unsmoothed retro pixels.

mipmaps.description: Generate mipmaps before applying the texture filter.

lod_bias.description: Positive mip LOD bias for noisy textures; higher values sample softer mip levels.

lighting.description: Whether the material participates in r3d lighting.

metallic.description: Lit material metallic response from 0 to 1.

specular.description: Base reflectivity multiplier for non-metal materials from 0 to 1.

blend.description: Blend mode used when transparency is active.

height_scale.description: Height/parallax scale reserved for custom material shaders. The r3d default material does not consume this yet.
